title: Weighted approximate tangent spaces on a C¹ chart (parent P4; Simon Ch. 3, 1.6 ⇒ and Remark 1.8(1))
statement: Let V ⊆ ℝ^Q be open, M ⊆ V Hⁿ-null-measurable, θ > 0 on M with θ Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ V, and let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q be C¹ and antilipschitz on an open Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ M ∩ Φ(Ω) and the (unique) w ∈ Ω with Φ(w) = y, DΦ(w)(ℝⁿ) is the weighted approximate tangent space of M with respect to θ at y (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y (range DΦ(w))).
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (V M : Set (Eucl Q)) (θ : Eucl Q → ℝ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)), IsOpen V → M ⊆ V → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 < θ y) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) → IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ∀ᵐ y ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)).restrict (M ∩ Φ '' Ω)), ∀ w ∈ Ω, Φ w = y → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap)
